docs.summary: Group triangles by the cube face their normal points at, cut the groups into connected charts, and flatten each by dropping it onto its projection plane. Near-instant and overlap-free on well-formed geometry, at the cost of stretch on slanted surfaces and more charts than a conformal solve would need.

Lloyd-style chart segmentation, angle-based flattening (LinABF) and a least-squares conformal map (LSCM), with per-chart overlap validation. Far lower distortion and far fewer seams; orders of magnitude slower.
